ts-aceh-peace.title: Waizenegger and Hyndman, Two Solitudes: Post-tsunami and Post-conflict Aceh
ts-aceh-peace.notes: Post-tsunami and post-conflict aid disparities, 2005 Helsinki agreement and limits of disaster diplomacy. Review: abstract_only_peer_reviewed_paper. Limits: Only abstract inspected; do not infer detailed interview results beyond abstract.

ts-srilanka-mou.title: Sri Lanka, Memorandum for Post-Tsunami Operational Management Structure (2005)
ts-srilanka-mou.notes: June 2005 Sri Lanka government/LTTE reconstruction governance proposal and its stated ethnic scope. Review: direct_html_primary_agreement. Limits: Agreement documents intentions, not implementation, acceptance or lasting effects.

ts-unesco-iot.title: UNESCO-IOC, Indian Ocean Tsunami Warning and Mitigation System
ts-unesco-iot.notes: Post-2004 multilateral coordination and 2005 establishment. Review: direct_html_institutional_current_description. Limits: Contemporary membership figures must not be projected back to 2005.

ts-india-warning.title: INCOIS, Indian Tsunami Early Warning System
ts-india-warning.notes: India interim 2005 warning service and October 2007 full round-the-clock center. Review: direct_html_official_indian_technology_overview. Limits: Official description is not an independent audit of local last-mile warning coverage.

cn-unctad.title: UNCTAD, World Investment Report 2002, China Export Processing and Foreign Affiliates
cn-unctad.notes: Export zones, foreign affiliates, and 1996–2000 trade by ownership in specific goods. Review: search_indexed_primary_trade_research_excerpt. Limits: PDF table and sample do not define all Chinese exports; do not infer subsequent years mechanically.

cn-wto.title: World Trade Organization, China Accession Record
cn-wto.notes: 11 December 2001 accession and negotiated trade commitments. Review: direct_html_primary_membership_record. Limits: Membership explains formal rules, not their distributional effects.

cn-oecd.title: OECD Economic Surveys: China 2010
cn-oecd.notes: Migrant labor, hukou access, worker contracts and 2008 labor law. Review: search_indexed_2010_OECD_survey_excerpt. Limits: Government and OECD data use changing coverage; cannot infer all individuals or labor conditions.

cn-labor-law.title: PRC Labor Contract Law (adopted 2007, in force 2008), English translation
cn-labor-law.notes: Statutory labor contract and employer duties, dates. Review: direct_html_primary_law_translation. Limits: Written rights are not proof of enforcement or equal bargaining power.

cn-cecc.title: Congressional-Executive Commission on China, 2007 Annual Report
cn-cecc.notes: Labor-rights disputes, oversight and implementation concerns. Review: direct_html_US_congressional_monitoring. Limits: U.S. commission perspective; case reports cannot stand for every factory.

cn-env.title: Congressional-Executive Commission on China, 2007 Annual Report: Environment
cn-env.notes: Environmental impacts, Chinese policy acknowledgements and reported pollution. Review: direct_html_US_congressional_report. Limits: Reported mortality or exposure estimates require source-specific methodology; no precise figures asserted.

cn-stimulus.title: Library of Congress, China Economic Stimulus Plan Unveiled (2008)
cn-stimulus.notes: November 2008 four-trillion-renminbi announced investment response and financing caveats. Review: direct_html_contemporaneous_legal_monitor. Limits: Headline package is a planned amount and not direct cash spending.

cn-crs-crisis.title: Congressional Research Service, China and the Global Financial Crisis
cn-crs-crisis.notes: Crisis-driven export slowdown and China financing and infrastructure response. Review: direct_html_retrospective_policy_analysis. Limits: U.S. policy audience and uncertainty about how much spending was new.

a2-ghana.title: Inter-Parliamentary Union, Ghana 2000 Parliamentary Election Summary
a2-ghana.notes: 2000 election and transfer of political leadership in Ghana. Review: direct_html_election_archive. Limits: Parliamentary election summary does not itself establish electoral accountability afterward.

a2-ghana-law.title: Ghana Electoral Commission, Declaration of President-Elect (2000)
a2-ghana-law.notes: Official declaration of John Agyekum Kufuor after 28 December 2000 runoff. Review: direct_html_primary_election_instrument. Limits: Legal declaration documents the result, not the quality of every polling station.

a2-au.title: African Union, About the African Union
a2-au.notes: July 2002 Durban launch and stated organization principles. Review: direct_html_primary_institution_history. Limits: Organizational goals must be distinguished from implementation.

a2-nepad.title: UN Economic Commission for Africa, The New Partnership for Africa’s Development (October 2001)
a2-nepad.notes: Original African-led 2001 development goals and proposed international relationship. Review: direct_html_contemporaneous_program_text. Limits: Document records program aspirations, not measured results.

a2-nigeria.title: U.S. State Department, Nigeria Human Rights Report 2000
a2-nigeria.notes: 1999 civilian government transition, constitution and issues of judicial independence. Review: direct_html_contemporaneous_foreign_human_rights_report. Limits: External government viewpoint; requires Nigerian perspectives for full political analysis.

a2-hrw-nigeria.title: Human Rights Watch, Current Human Rights Concerns on Nigeria (1999)
a2-hrw-nigeria.notes: 1999 election irregularities, abuses and rights concerns. Review: direct_html_contemporaneous_human_rights_report. Limits: Spotlight on rights deficiencies, not a full social-economic history of Nigeria.

a2-kenya-waki.title: Human Rights Watch, Turning Pebbles: Evading Accountability in Kenya
a2-kenya-waki.notes: 2007–08 post-election violence, Waki Commission 1,133 deaths and February 2008 accord. Review: direct_html_investigative_with_commission_citation. Limits: Commission death total is a documented finding, not an exhaustive count of all subsequent abuses.

a2-tac.title: South African Constitutional Court, Minister of Health v Treatment Action Campaign (2002)
a2-tac.notes: Nevirapine restrictions and court judgment, role of Treatment Action Campaign. Review: direct_html_primary_judgment. Limits: Court order is not evidence that nationwide implementation was immediate.

a2-sa-court.title: Constitutional Court of South Africa, Minister of Health v TAC, July 2002
a2-sa-court.notes: Detailed findings on legal duty concerning mother-to-child transmission prevention. Review: direct_html_primary_judgment. Limits: Limited to legal dispute and evidence before court, not all later treatment outcomes.

a2-msf.title: Médecins Sans Frontières, MSF in South Africa 2000–2020
a2-msf.notes: Khayelitsha treatment programs and civil-society contributions. Review: direct_html_provider_retrospective. Limits: Provider history describes its program and does not represent every South African clinic.

a2-debt.title: IMF, Multilateral Debt Relief Initiative FAQ
a2-debt.notes: HIPC and 2005/2006 MDRI debt-relief chronology and design. Review: direct_html_institutional_policy_retrospective. Limits: Institutional perspective; debt cancellation does not establish household outcomes.

a2-mpesa.title: Financial Sector Deepening Kenya, An Overview of M-PESA
a2-mpesa.notes: March 2007 launch, customer transfers, regulatory and agent-network context. Review: direct_html_financial_inclusion_case_study. Limits: Retrospective highlights achievements and cannot prove universal coverage.

fi-fcic.title: Financial Crisis Inquiry Commission, Conclusions and Dissents (2011)
fi-fcic.notes: Majority findings and published dissenting accounts; mortgage and systemic vulnerabilities. Review: direct_html_public_inquiry_report. Limits: Interpretation is contested; report conclusions and dissent are distinct positions.

fi-fed-history.title: Federal Reserve History, Great Recession and Its Aftermath
fi-fed-history.notes: 2007–09 housing and banking chronology, recession severity and policy response. Review: direct_html_central_bank_historical_synthesis. Limits: Federal Reserve institutional perspective and retrospective estimates.

fi-fdic.title: FDIC, Crisis and Response: An FDIC History, 2008–2013
fi-fdic.notes: 2007–08 chronology, Bear Stearns, Lehman, AIG, government responses. Review: direct_html_FDIC_book_overview_table. Limits: Institutional post hoc history, events do not prove one cause; the detailed book was not independently reviewed in full.

fi-uk-rock.title: UK Parliament, Report on the Nationalisation of Northern Rock (2009)
fi-uk-rock.notes: 2007 wholesale funding collapse, deposit run and 2008 nationalization. Review: direct_html_parliamentary_summary. Limits: Parliamentary oversight account does not fully explain all British banks.

fi-treasury.title: U.S. Department of the Treasury, About TARP
fi-treasury.notes: 2008 stabilization program authorization, institutional chronology and implementation. Review: direct_html_official_policy_history. Limits: Program authorization is not cash spent or a claim about net cost; officials explain their own actions.

fi-fed-swaps.title: Federal Reserve Board, Dollar Funding Coordination, 13 October 2008
fi-fed-swaps.notes: Coordinated international dollar liquidity measures with European and Japanese central banks. Review: direct_html_contemporaneous_press_release. Limits: Announcement is policy intent, not an evaluation of market effects.

fi-fed-em.title: Federal Reserve Board, Swap Lines with Brazil, Mexico, Korea and Singapore (29 Oct 2008)
fi-fed-em.notes: Later October 2008 global liquidity coordination beyond Europe and Japan. Review: direct_html_contemporaneous_press_release. Limits: Announcement does not quantify country-level outcomes.

fi-bls.title: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, The Recession of 2007–2009
fi-bls.notes: Labor market downturn, June 2009 recession end and October 2009 unemployment peak. Review: direct_html_official_labor_statistics. Limits: Aggregate employment figures do not establish the experience of a particular community.
